facts.statement: Free Agents are players who sign up and are selected to play Free Realms with special access, then give feedback and spread the word about the game.
facts.quote: Free Realms Free Agents are a group of players who sign up and are selected to play Free Realms with special access.

facts.statement: Sony Online Entertainment would announce Free Agent recruiting on the Free Realms What's New web page, via an ad banner or news feed.
facts.quote: Sony Online Entertainment will announce when it will be recruiting for players to join Free Agents on the Free Realms What's New web page.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Free Agents
article_summaries.summary: This is a freerealms.com help/FAQ page describing the Free Agents program: selected players get special access to play Free Realms, give feedback, and promote the game. It says recruitment would be announced on the What's New page and that Free Agents get member content at no additional charge. The page was captured in March 2009, before the April 2009 launch, so the program details are pre-launch.
